subject.title: fix: models status auth, browser local-file nav, codex workspace app-server, tui empty sessions

question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns gain network access by default, or should network remain tied to the existing OpenClaw sandbox egress or another explicit opt-in path?
rationale: The PR changes an existing sandbox boundary for upgraded users, while Codex defaults workspace-write network access to false and prior OpenClaw work made egress conditional rather than unconditional.

options.title: Keep default denied or conditional
options.body: Preserve the existing default-denied behavior and only allow network when an existing approved egress policy or explicit maintainer-approved opt-in applies.

options.title: Accept network by default
options.body: Intentionally make workspace-write app-server turns network-enabled by default with matching docs, upgrade notes, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Split the sandbox change
options.body: Move the sandbox network decision into a separate PR so the narrower TUI, browser, and auth fixes can proceed independently.

recommendation.title: Keep default denied or conditional
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing default-denied behavior and only allow network when an existing approved egress policy or explicit maintainer-approved opt-in applies.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged PR #83502 made the related app-server sandbox egress decision conditional, and the same history overlaps this security-boundary question.
